settings.editor: How It Works

settings.title: From raw data to action in hours - not weeks.

settings.editor: Halo normalizes data from your DMS, CRM, inventory platform, and marketing channels — then runs AI signal scans nightly so your team can start each day knowing exactly where to focus.

settings.description_text: DealerVault DMS files, vAuto inventory, VinSolutions CRM, Google, Meta, and Bing — all ingested on a nightly basis into a normalized, dealer-mapped data layer.
Agents check pace-to-goal, inventory health, service capture, marketing performance, and retention signals across every rooftop simultaneously.
Role-based alert panels for GMs, GSMs, BDC managers, and fixed ops. What changed, why it changed, and what to do about it — without digging through dashboards.
Every alert has a measurable outcome. Halo tracks whether action was taken, quantifies the impact, and builds historical context that makes future signals sharper.

Common Questions

settings.title: Answers for the real questions Dealers ask.
Is Halo OS replacing my CRM, DMS, or inventory tools?

settings.editor: No. Halo connects to and normalizes data from the tools you already use — VinSolutions, CDK, vAuto, and others. It surfaces intelligence from those systems, it doesn't replace them.

settings.title: Is this just another dashboard I have to check?

settings.editor: No. Halo is built so your team doesn't have to stare at dashboards. AI agents run daily and push prioritized alerts to the right roles. The insight comes to you.

settings.title: Can the AI be customized to our workflows?

settings.editor: Yes. Alert thresholds, targets, scoring weights, and role-based surfaces are all configurable per rooftop and group. The system learns your baselines over time and adjusts accordingly.

settings.title: What about data ownership and privacy?

settings.editor: Your data stays in your controlled environment. Halo does not expose your operational data to external LLMs, does not share data across dealer groups, and maintains full audit trails.

settings.title: Can I deploy to one store or my whole group?

settings.editor: Both. Halo is modular by design. Start with a single rooftop, validate the value, and expand across your group at your pace. The group-level view activates as more rooftops connect.

settings.title: How fast can we get live?

settings.editor: Onboarding timelines depend on your data sources and the number of rooftops. We handle the integration configuration — your team's primary lift is the initial dealer identity mapping setup.
